title: Laparoscopic Sentinel Lymph Node Localization in Operable Cervix Cancer
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the feasibility, safety and efficacy of laparoscopic ovarian transposition in women less than 40 years of age with locally advanced cervical squamous cell carcinoma
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Stage IAI to IIA cervix cancer undergoing primary surgical management

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous pelvic dissection
* Previous para-aortic lymph node dissection
* Evidence of distant mets
